summary: Configured a persistent Squid forward proxy on node1:3128 and the preserved handbook origin on node2:8081. Approved HTTP succeeds; other ports and all CONNECT tunnels receive 403. Both nodes passed sequential restart-persistence verification.
actions_performed: Installed Ubuntu Xenial-compatible Squid 3.5.12 on node1.
Configured Squid to allow only node2 → node2:8081 over plain HTTP and deny all CONNECT requests and other traffic.
Created and enabled a systemd service for the existing staged origin without modifying the handbook.
Verified allowed and denied requests before and after restarts.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually, confirming changed boot identities and complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: HTTP forward proxy on node1 TCP 3128
evidence.summary: Squid is active and listening on *:3128; final configuration parses successfully and package version is 3.5.12-1ubuntu7.16.

evidence.requirement: Preserve and serve the staged handbook origin on node2:8081
evidence.summary: The handbook SHA-256 remained 57045b08ae66a141b4d6fc48276c174675141001dc1320026adc15bf5b5dbc06; the enabled origin listens on 8081 and returns the expected revision 3 text.

evidence.requirement: Permit approved origin and reject other destination ports and CONNECT tunnels
evidence.summary: End-to-end tests consistently returned the handbook through the proxy, 403 for HTTP to port 22, and 403 for CONNECT to port 8081. Squid logs show TCP_MISS/200 and TCP_DENIED/403 outcomes.

evidence.requirement: Keep installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on Ubuntu 16.04.7 LTS with kernel 4.4.0-210-generic before and after changes and restarts.
Boot ID changed from 6ab98831-2739-47d3-b99c-0784ebb8b49e to 73289816-cb2e-4384-9afa-66c7b0b0c1ab. Squid, its listener, policy digest, and all allow/deny behavior recovered.

Boot ID changed from 0d49f077-ed5b-479a-b08e-ec4392d89c52 to 9869bc02-9557-40ce-b1ca-e30689327855. The origin service, listener, handbook digest, direct response, proxied response, and denial policy recovered.
